privacy_promise.headline: Local runs · your data stays yours until you share
privacy_promise.scout_runs: Every Voyage and panic scout runs read-only on your Macintosh · Innsegall does not receive filenames, paths, browsing history, keystrokes, or Battle Scout bodies.
privacy_promise.panic_extra: The $4.20 panic scout uses the same local engine · payment only unlocks quota on your device · no cloud upload of check results.
privacy_promise.telemetry: Anonymous improvement telemetry is on by default · category counts only · never your Battle Scout · we don't want your data · only what helps improve the tools · opt out: innsegall plan --telemetry-off or INNSEGALL_TELEMETRY=0 · innsegall.com/privacy

privacy_promise.billing: Stripe sees payment metadata only · not your scout contents.
